raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Related to #43501. Follow-up to [@mgoin's request](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/43501#issuecomment-5716717828) to roll out manual fusion in model batches.

Route Qwen2MoeMLP through the existing manual activation/quantization fusion. This covers Qwen1.5-MoE, Qwen2-MoE and the reused Qwen3Next MLP, including shared experts. The shared-expert gate still uses the original input.

Native FP8 engagement needs #57514's consumer-key exposure. No kernel or consumer changes are included here.

## Tests

1× H100 80GB, TP1, with nightly binaries:

- Shared-expert FP8 regression: passes with the change, fails without it.
- Qwen2-57B-A14B FP8 with #57514: fusion runs in all 28 shared MLPs. With #59514 too, sampled GSM8K scored 204/256 → 207/256; compiled throughput rose 0.9–1.8% (three runs). Without #59514, throughput was unchanged.

nodes.body:
*Posted by Claude Code on behalf of @gau-nernst.*

I pushed 71d21b0968, which drops the Qwen2MoeMLP test. The change is a call-site adoption like llama/pixtral, and the fusion itself is already covered by `test_silu_mul_quant_manual_fusion.py` and `test_fused_quant_activation.py`.

Supporting NVFP4 data on GB300, from a branch with the identical change (same GPU, A B A B, shared FlashInfer autotune cache).

**Engagement** (Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-NVFP4, eager trace, 4-token generate):

| Kernel | main | this PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| `act_and_mul_kernel` | 192 | 0 |
| `silu_mul_cvt_fp16_to_fp4` | 0 | 192 |
| `cvt_fp16_to_fp4` | 576 | 384 |

**Accuracy** (GSM8K flexible-extract, 1319 questions; standard error ≈ 0.009):

| Model | main | this PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-NVFP4 | 0.8893 | 0.8840 |
| Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 | 0.8628 | 0.8560 |

**Act+quant step** (CUPTI, CUDA graph, cold L2, [M, 2×17408] bf16 input):

| M | `silu_and_mul` + `scaled_fp4_quant` (µs) | `silu_and_mul_nvfp4_quant` (µs) |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 8.03 | 2.69 |
| 128 | 9.31 | 5.28 |
| 2048 | 83.68 | 34.75 |
| 8192 | 310.91 | 124.99 |

**E2E TPOT, 1k/512** (TP1, ms; mean of 2 rounds, except Qwen3-Next, 1 round). Default torch.compile is neutral since the compile pass already fuses this pair; the gain shows without it:

| Model, mode | C | main | this PR | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-NVFP4, default compile | 1 | 3.301 | 3.292 | −0.3% |
| | 16 | 5.038 | 4.980 | −1.2% |
| Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4, default compile | 1 | 5.47 | 5.46 | −0.1% |
| | 16 | 6.77 | 6.80 | +0.5% |
| Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4, `-O0` (1k/128) | 1 | 142.2 | 137.5 | −3.3% |
| | 16 | 146.0 | 141.4 | −3.1% |
| Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4, no-compile path (#51012) | 1 | 5.33 | 5.11 | −4.1% |
| | 16 | 6.86 | 6.72 | −2.1% |
| | 64 | 11.66 | 11.19 | −4.1% |

LGTM.
